Subject: Allocation proposal for third-party IP claims (Order Form)

Vanessa / team —

Thanks for the demo last week. Legal asked us to put forward a concrete proposal for how Aurelia and Redwood would split responsibility if a third-party patent/ copyright claim arises from models used under the order form. Attached is a ZIP with a few historical notices (redacted).

Our starting position: customer handles remediation for customer-provided data and plugins; vendor (Redwood) handles model-origin claims and indemnifies for third-party patent claims that arise from the model core. We understand Redwood’s constraints around defend vs reimburse and insurance offsets.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept (i) defense control for model-origin patent assertions up to $5M (with option to step in), and (ii) a cooperation timeline for evidence handoff (we propose 10 business days)?

Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

—Evan
Head of Procurement, Aurelia Systems

Evan —

Thanks for the proposal and the evidence bundle. Appreciate the clarity; that helps. High level: we can likely accept (i) defense control for model-origin patent assertions up to $5M with standard cooperation requirements, but we need a few guardrails: insurance offset language, obligation to mitigate and a more specific evidence staging plan.

I'm looping in Kimberly (Legal) and Ben (CS lead). Kimber, see the attachments Evan shared — can you confirm whether defense-control up to $5M is workable and whether we should push for a notice window longer than 10 business days?

Next steps I propose:
- Redwood to send an annotated order form redline (pdf) with defend-vs-reimburse options and insurance offset clause.
- Joint MAP (mutual action plan) that sets evidence handoff SLA, contact roles, and privilege handling.
- 30-minute legal sync today at 2pm PT if that works for Aurelia.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of GTM Ops, Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodai.com>

Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2029-05-11T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Allocation proposal for third-party IP claims (Order Form)

Evan / Vanessa / team —

Quick legal read: defense control up to a $5M cap is potentially acceptable to Redwood with these modifications:
1) Insurance offset: Redwood’s liability reduced by recoveries from applicable insurance (carrier-level), with explicit carve-out that does not reduce Redwood’s duty to indemnify if carrier refuses coverage in bad faith.
2) Narrowed trigger: claims must arise from Redwood-delivered model artifacts or Redwood-managed deployment (not customer prompts or customer-supplied models/plugins).
3) Evidence handoff MAP: 10 business days is a reasonable target but we need a staged handoff (initial notice + priority evidence within 72 hours, full bundle within 10 business days). This helps triage.
4) Defense control mechanics: Redwood can assume defense but must allow Aurelia to participate and retain approval rights over settlement that admits liability or imposes non-monetary obligations.

I will draft an annotated order form redline and a short MAP doc (see attached working doc). Ben / Lauren, can you confirm operational timelines for privileged evidence collection and whether our SOC/forensics team can commit to the 72-hour triage window?

-Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

[attachment: MAP-Aurelia-RWI-20290511.docx]

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodai.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodai.com>, Evan Morales <evan.morales@aurelia-sys.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2029-05-11T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Allocation proposal for third-party IP claims (Order Form)

Evan —

Operationally we can commit to the staged evidence handoff Kimberly outlined. Notes:
- Triage: we can pledge 72 hours for initial triage for high-priority evidence (logs, snapshots, sample prompts) provided the request includes sufficient context and a signed NDA/privilege preservation notice.
- Full bundle: 10 business days is OK but depends on jurisdictional restrictions (EU data subject requests might extend timelines).
- Contact points: I'll be the primary ops lead; Lauren will handle legal ops escalation.

If you confirm we will create a short runbook and a Slack + PagerDuty channel for escalation.

—Ben Carter
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
